Name: Ria's Second Farmhouse
Author: Ria114
Description:
[b][u][size=4]Update[/size][/u][/b]
[size=3]
Finally I had some time to rework my second Farmhouse.

You can now enable/disable each Farmhouseupgrade. You can also change the Trim, the Panels, the Windows an the Columns of the Farmhouse. Maybe you want the Trim from RCTI and the Panels from Starblue. Now you can combine them as you like.

You can buy all additional Rooms by Robin except the "Remove DiningRoom Wall"[/size]

[size=3]If you have some issues, i.e. Cellar disappears, you can use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16507]this Mod[/url]. Maybe it helps.
I also recommend using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3900]NoClipMod[/url][/size].

[size=3]Recolor Options:
DaisyNiko Earth Interior
Rustic Country
White
Starblue
[/size]
[size=3]Please tell me if there are some issues.[/size]

Have fun :)

[b][u][size=4]Installation[/size][/u][/b]
[size=3]1. [url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
2. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install Content Patcher[/url].
3. Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.
4. Run the game using SMAPI.
[/size]
[b][u][size=4]Compatibility[/size][/u][/b]
I don't know, if this mod is compatible with other mods that touches / changes the inside of the farmhouse.

Downloads.Description: Crib is now removable... who needs kids :P
